title: [Solved] Tiles only shown in editor, but not ingame

posts.author: VeniVidiRici
posts.body:
Hi there!
I stumbled across a problem I cannot solve while doing a graphic overwork of my ingame town:
I made a custom tileset for walls and roofs (PNG) and put all the tiles in the layer above the player (I used empty events to block the player movement as usual). I can visually place them when working in the editor, but when I test it ingame all the placed tiles are invisible and the earlier tiles are shown (mostly grass and some old walls).
Does anyone know what the problem is and how to fix it?
I attached some screenshots (editor, ingame and tileset) to help you understand my issue.

posts.author: TheTitan99
posts.body:
That's very strange! I don't know why this would be happening off the top of my head. For troubleshooting ideas...
What version of MV are you using?
Are you using plugins? If so, can you show the plugin list?
Can you post the tileset .png itself?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
please do NOT use spaces in filenames
Browsers (and you are creating a browser game) have problems with loading files that contain symbols and letters forbidden under networking rules, and space is one of them (which is why all default tilesheets use underscore _ instead of spaces.
that is seen in your screenshot, but another cause for this is if the tilesheet is larger than allowed.
test renaming first, and if that doesn't help post the tilesheet itself for checkup
